title: Renewal dates and terms diverge

retrieve_on.symptom_narrative: Contracts, billing and the renewal spreadsheet are separate. Email extensions and added equipment remain in messages. A customer arranged a competitor’s copier while we thought renewal was months away. Sales lacks a reliable service history before discussing the next agreement.
retrieve_on.workflow_context: Rental and maintenance provider; approximately 140 active agreements.

discriminating_questions.question: Which document controls the date?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: A later email extension was accepted but never reflected in the sheet.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: A customer with a deliberate competitive tender needs tender tracking; an earlier reminder alone may not retain it.

discriminating_questions.question: Who owns renewal follow-up?
discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Sales and accounts each assumed the other was tracking it.
discriminating_questions.branch_if_answer_differs: Revise the causal hypothesis and request the corresponding source record; do not reuse this fictional answer for a new customer.

discriminating_questions.synthetic_answer: Service complaints or old equipment can change the proposal.

positive_mechanism: Agreement versions and decision deadlines are not reconciled into an owned renewal workflow.
counterexample: A customer with a deliberate competitive tender needs tender tracking; an earlier reminder alone may not retain it.
minimum_evidence: A simulated amendment changes the end date.
A simulated spreadsheet retains the original date.
A simulated account has unresolved repeat failures.
process_intervention: Review the current agreement and amendments; assign an account owner and separate notice, review and end dates.
automation_candidate: Extract date candidates for review; maintain effective terms; prepare account summaries and internal renewal tasks.
unknowns: Notice interpretations, negotiation lead time and completeness of amendments need review.
stop_rule: If discriminating evidence is absent or conflicting, return an unresolved hypothesis plus a targeted question, not a confident solution.

capability_boundary.proposed_extension: Agreement versioning and renewal management are proposed additions.
capability_boundary.pricing: No price assigned; current rate card must not be extended by analogy.
